title: Input vector for paired encoding
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $r$ be a finite bit string, and let $v$ assign a bit to each of the $n$ input positions. The finite vector of bits obtained by evaluating the wiring for the paired encoding of $v$ and $r$ is exactly the paired encoding of the list of values of $v$ and the string $r$.
hypotheses_covered: $v$ assigns a Boolean value to each index below $n$
